description: Election Commission - R. Suthahar was selected as the member of the Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the composition of elected bodies, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which cover "candidate nominations and registrations" and "electoral commission appointments and decisions."
